fact: Since November 2022 Namibia's Ministry of Agriculture, Water and Land Reform has collected field data in seven northern regions with FAO and UMD/NASA Harvest for remote sensing yield forecast models, and a ministry analyst says remote sensing has enabled extensive, timely data collection.
title: FAO and UMD/NASA Harvest Partnership Strengthens Capacity for Crop Yield Estimation and Food Security Assessment in Namibia's Northern Regions
